title: Shorten the binary caller and independently verify its cost ceiling (no new κ)
body:
Give a distinct four-query word with the same six-input endpoint as #6766: 20 literal events instead of 21, or 22 instead of 23 after identical final normalizers. A four-input variant uses 18 events. Full q^4 coefficients and characteristic-two transfer agree. Event counts imply no weighted physical-cost saving.

Independently confirm the existing COMPLEX ceiling 0.0033072446849 with directed integer square roots and a separate rational atanh/Taylor checker. #6766 receives priority for the shared endpoint and broader COMPLEX+BIT result.

Base: 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a.
#6726: 435bbe91fb28cb1d7a569ca70c6c4e9eb302d486.
#6764: 1153341fb288bd4cd3c9eba490b6dec4e2e6d43c.
#6766: d87e4a38890f6962162d00a68031ab2476f58f6e.
Exact retained hashes and unchanged notices: SOURCES.json.

Reproduce (Python 3.12, stdlib):
```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/binary-equal-orientation-fragments
```
Expected: `PASS_BINARY_EQUAL_ORIENTATION_FRAGMENT_PACKAGE`, `PASS_INDEPENDENT_ATANH_TREE_REVIEW`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.

Executed: exact 4/6-input maps and inverses; all 20 event omissions; phase, alias, normalizer, source and missing-query controls; 44 finite totals and an analytic unbounded tail. The independent engine includes 2,352 orientation comparisons and 15,180 triples. Positive local-gain controls prevent overstating the obstruction. Normal/-O, metadata, committed bytes/modes, export and Git-free checks pass. No randomized construction search.

No new κ. Fixed native tariffs, root and independently paid idles only. Physical installation, changed idle-sharing interfaces, roots and native tariffs remain open. All five selected assumptions remain.

By @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and separate mathematical/arithmetic review. Credit Cinna Davis, Ali Romman (#6398), thu-nmrc (#6716/#6717), zxv (#6726), and #6764/#6766. No human/proof-kernel acceptance.

Proof, comparison and limits: https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/tree/a8dcada906c0b6e4bd0bba171ae45a5271a80cd4/research/binary-equal-orientation-fragments
Complete remote Git tree matches the tested contribution.
